Messages.Author: drnlmza
Messages.Body:
Currently, the list of rulings has the following for Mehemet of the Ahl-i-Batin:

> rulings wrote:
> If the Discipline card is controlled by a Methuselah other than the controller of the vampire it is on, Mehemet's action to burn it and a blood from the vampire is undirected. [LSJ 20010816]
>
The rulebook, however, says:

> Non-existant user wrote:
> If the action targets one or more other Methuselahs (or things controlled by other Methuselahs), then the action is called directed, and only the Methuselahs who are targeted (or control the targets) may use their ready untapped minions to attempt to block the action
>
which would make Mehemet's action directed at both the controller of the discipline card and the vampire targeted, rather than undirected.

I assume this discrepancy is merely because of the age of the ruling, and it's no longer valid. That correct?

--
National Coordinator
South Africa

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Correct. The ruling doesn't apply anymore. I'll remove it from that list. Thanks
